creators.name: XGEN Labs
creators.bio: A world-model company founded in 2026 and operated as XGEN Labs Limited in Hong Kong; in September 2026 it announced Generative World Simulation (the DAO world engine and the open JING experience model, technical report October 2026) and published Dual Exam, an evaluation of agents and world models working together.
creators.why: Pairs a generated first-person view with an explicit shared world state, so consequences remain after an observer leaves.
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2026 年的世界模型公司，以 XGEN Labs Limited（原初之境科技有限公司）在香港运营；2026 年 9 月发布“生成式世界模拟”（世界引擎 DAO 与开源体验模型 JING，技术报告于 10 月发布），并发表了评估智能体与世界模型协同工作的 Dual Exam。
creators.why_zh: 把生成的第一人称画面与一个明确的共享世界状态结合起来，观察者离开后，行动的后果依然存在。

creators.name: Zhexiao Xiong
creators.role: Researcher at Washington University in St. Louis; first author of ActWorld
creators.bio: First author of ActWorld (NeurIPS 2026), an interactive world model with object interaction, written during an internship with ByteDance's Intelligent Creation team.
creators.why: Works on world models in which a player can act on objects, not only move through a scene.
creators.role_zh: 圣路易斯华盛顿大学研究者，ActWorld 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: ActWorld（NeurIPS 2026）的第一作者。这是一个支持物体交互的交互式世界模型，完成于其在字节跳动智能创作团队实习期间。
creators.why_zh: 研究玩家不只能在场景中移动、还能动手操作物体的世界模型。

works.title: DAO and JING
works.description: A generative world simulation from XGEN Labs in two parts: DAO, a world engine that keeps the state of characters, objects and places, lets autonomous characters act on their own goals and advances everything by rules and world time, and JING, a model that renders each observer's first-person video and sound from what that observer can perceive. As of October 2026 only JING is public, as open weights that turn a scripted sequence of keyboard and text controls into 5–15 s clips; DAO, the causal real-time JING and the multi-observer town on the project page are shown in videos and the technical report but not released.
works.description_zh: XGEN Labs 推出的生成式世界模拟，分为两部分：DAO 是一个世界引擎，记录角色、物体与空间的状态，让自主角色按各自目标行动，并按规则与世界时间推进一切；JING 是一个模型，根据每位观察者能感知到的内容生成第一人称的画面与声音。截至 2026 年 10 月，公开的只有 JING：开源权重可以把一段预先写好的键盘与文字操作序列生成为 5–15 秒的片段；DAO、因果实时版 JING 以及项目页上的多观察者小镇只出现在视频与技术报告中，尚未发布。
works.idea_en: Separates the world from the picture of it: consequences live in an explicit shared state that outlasts any one viewer, and the video model renders only what each observer can perceive.
works.idea_zh: 把世界本身与世界的画面分开：后果保存在一个明确的共享状态里，不会因某个观察者离开而消失；视频模型只渲染每位观察者能感知到的部分。
works.method: DAO holds an entity graph, actor states (intentions, emotions, needs), a world clock and active events, admits actions against reachability and rule checks, advances the state in ordered update cycles with snapshots and event history, and reads out observer-specific conditions (sensing range, field of view, occlusion) for JING; JING adapts MiniMax-H3's joint audio-video DiT with a FiLM camera-control encoder, causal chunked generation trained with resampling forcing, an audiovisual memory retrieved by attention-key similarity, and VMM-initialised DMD distillation to four steps; the released JING-Flash-v1 is the four-step bidirectional variant.
works.method_zh: DAO 维护一张实体图、角色状态（意图、情绪、需求）、世界时钟与正在发生的事件；它按可达性与规则检查接受或拒绝动作，以有序的更新循环推进状态，并用快照与事件历史保存下来，再按感知范围、视野与遮挡为每位观察者生成交给 JING 的条件。JING 在 MiniMax-H3 音视频联合 DiT 的基础上加入 FiLM 镜头控制编码器，用重采样强制（resampling forcing）训练分块因果生成，按注意力键相似度检索音视频记忆，并以 VMM 初始化、DMD 蒸馏到四步。已发布的 JING-Flash-v1 是四步双向版本。
works.specs: JING-Flash-v1 · 4-step bidirectional · video + stereo audio · reference demo on 6× H100 · Hugging Face Space: 5–15 s at 1344×768 or 960×544, 24 fps · WBench Full 81.0 (#1 on 2026-09-17, #2 behind Murea-Pro by 2026-10-12; self-evaluated) · Navi 81.9 (#2) · no latency figure published

works.title: Alaya-EVOKE
works.description: An open interactive world model from Alaya Lab that streams video under camera control for as long as a session lasts, keeps scene geometry outside the model in a store indexed by camera pose, and accepts new prompts mid-rollout (an aurora lights up, a storm rolls in) without a cut. Its Turbo version was listed first on WBench's navigation track (82.0) on 2026-09-11.
works.description_zh: Alaya Lab 推出的开源交互世界模型：在镜头控制下持续流式生成视频，会话多长都可以；场景几何保存在模型之外、按相机位姿索引的存储里；生成过程中可以随时更换提示（极光亮起、风暴来临），画面不中断。其 Turbo 版本于 2026 年 9 月 11 日在 WBench 导航赛道以 82.0 分位列第一。
works.idea_en: Moving memory out of the model's context lets a session run on without trading its length against what the world remembers.
works.idea_zh: 把记忆移出模型的上下文，会话就能一直进行下去，不必在时长与世界记得多少之间取舍。
works.method: A three-step student without classifier-free guidance is distilled with a 30-second distribution-matching objective under self-forced rollouts from a long-horizon teacher built on LingBot-World, whose sparse attention (chunk grouping, retrieval of selected distant frames and a linear-attention global state) grows linearly in memory and compute; at inference only view-relevant geometry is read from the external world state bank.
works.method_zh: 在自强制（self-forced）滚动生成下，用 30 秒的分布匹配目标，从一个基于 LingBot-World 的长时程教师模型蒸馏出三步、无需无分类器引导的学生模型；教师的稀疏注意力结合分块分组、远处关键帧检索与线性注意力全局状态，显存与计算随时长线性增长。推理时只从外部世界状态库读取与当前视角相关的几何信息。
works.specs: 384×640 · 3 steps, no CFG · 1.5 s chunk in 2.11 s on one H200 · WBench Navi 82.0 (Evoke-Turbo, 2026-09-11)

paper.title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World

works.title: ActWorld
works.description: An interactive world model from ByteDance's Intelligent Creation team and Washington University in St. Louis in which a player, under keyboard and mouse control, can act on things mid-rollout, such as inserting a coin, pressing a button or picking up a helmet, instead of only walking and looking around; objects keep their new state as play continues.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动智能创作团队与圣路易斯华盛顿大学提出的交互世界模型：玩家在键盘鼠标控制下，不只是行走和环顾，还能在生成过程中操作物体，例如投币、按按钮、拿起头盔；物体的新状态会在之后的游玩中保持下来。
works.idea_en: Turns a world you can look at into one you can act in: the action vocabulary grows from walking and turning to handling objects.
works.idea_zh: 把“可以看的世界”变成“可以动手的世界”：动作从行走、转身扩展到操作物体。
works.method: A chunk-autoregressive DiT takes high-level interaction commands and per-frame keyboard and mouse controls; a hierarchical action-aware memory keeps interaction-critical frames in the sliding window and a persistent bank of event-update and object-identity tokens beyond it, trained on a new 100K-video interaction dataset (40 action categories) captioned per chunk by a chain-of-thought VLM and evaluated on the authors' I-Bench.
works.method_zh: 分块自回归 DiT，输入高层交互指令与逐帧键盘鼠标控制；分层的动作感知记忆在滑动窗口内保留对交互关键的帧，并在窗口之外用持久记忆库保存事件更新与物体身份 token。训练数据是作者新建的 10 万段交互视频数据集（40 类动作），由思维链视觉语言模型逐块标注，并在作者提出的 I-Bench 上评测。
works.specs: 100K interaction videos · 40 action categories · per-frame keyboard + mouse

leads.name: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory for Video World Models (arXiv 2609.37690)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: academic paper without venue; fixed-size scene memory overlaps WorldCrafter, LOCI and ReWorld.

leads.name: Spatial Memory Intelligence (arXiv 2610.02521)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: academic paper without venue; MLLM-managed memory retrieval overlaps MemLearner and WorldCrafter.

leads.name: GameDirector (arXiv 2609.25652) and StatePlay (arXiv 2607.26754)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: NTU papers without venue; keeping game rules outside the renderer is already represented by Matrix-Game 4 (skywork--matrix-game-4).

leads.name: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents (arXiv 2610.20240)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: multiplayer Minecraft world modelling is covered by Solaris, and panoramic world state by PanoWorld.

leads.name: Generative World Simulation with DAO and JING (XGEN, arXiv 2610.19726)
leads.why: Added as xgen-labs--dao-jing.

leads.name: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview (arXiv 2606.30292)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: two-author preview built on LongLive with a Matrix-Game-style action path; low-compute world models are covered by MoWorld and MinWM.

leads.name: ABot-3DWorld 0 (AMAP / Alibaba, arXiv 2607.11673)
leads.why: Not a world-models work: it turns text, images or video into explorable 3DGS worlds (worlds-3d/explorable), and the official page shows no video as of 2026-10-18; re-list under worlds-3d if a video appears.

leads.name: WorldWeaver: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion with World State Registers (UCLA, arXiv 2607.21594)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: shared multi-agent world state is covered by Khora, WorldCast and Gamma-World.

leads.name: Cycle-World (ECCV 2026, arXiv 2607.11836)
leads.why: ECCV 2026 paper without project page, code or video as of 2026-10-18.

leads.name: GameWAM: A World Action Model for Video Games (arXiv 2608.26200)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: a four-author game-playing policy that also predicts frames (closer to agents/embodied), no venue.

leads.name: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models (arXiv 2610.01614)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: academic paper without venue; persistent interaction state and acting on new objects are represented by ActWorld and DAO and JING, added in this round.

leads.name: Prisma-World: Camera-Controllable Multi-Agent Video World Model (arXiv 2606.09507)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: multiplayer world models are covered by Solaris, WorldCast, Khora, Gamma-World, MIRA and Agora 2.

leads.name: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory (arXiv 2606.17730)
leads.why: Added as zhexiao-xiong--actworld.

leads.name: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression (KAIST, arXiv 2605.22718)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: training-free KV-cache retrieval overlaps WorldTrace, ReWorld and LOCI.

leads.name: BiWM: Advancing Open-Source Interactive Video World Models with Bidirectional Autoregression (arXiv 2606.10135)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: open training framework (LynnReal-AI/BiWM, demo only as a GitHub attachment) that overlaps MinWM (Shengshu) and SolarWM.

leads.name: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World (Alaya Lab, arXiv 2608.13546)
leads.why: Added as alaya-lab--alaya-evoke.

leads.name: ME-World: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction (KAIST, arXiv 2610.12299)
leads.why: Kept open: the paper is under review at ICLR 2027 (template header on the project page); add after decisions in late January 2027 if accepted. Videos and code exist (https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/ME-World/videos/teaser_video.mp4).

leads.name: AlayaVista: Streaming World Modeling from Panoramic States to Perspective Video (arXiv 2609.14462)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: panoramic world state overlaps MoVerse and PanoWorld; Alaya Lab is represented by AlayaWorld and Alaya-EVOKE.

leads.name: Decart Lucy 2 / Lucy 2.5 (2026)
leads.why: Covered by decart--lucy-2 (video/realtime), which also describes Lucy 2.5.

leads.name: Puffin-World (arXiv 2609.04196)
leads.why: Below the salience bar for both world-models and worlds-3d (decided here; the worlds-3d copy has the same name): NTU S-Lab open model whose generation follows a given camera path offline rather than reacting to actions, overlapping SANA-WM, Lyra and HunyuanWorld-Voyager; its main advance is gravity-aware camera understanding. Demo: https://kangliao929.github.io/projects/puffin-world/assets/puffin-world-demo-1080p.mp4
